core: Read the document. Select the smallest complete source span answering the question, then copy it faithfully. Return only <answer>...</answer>.

principles.scope: Requested role, cause, title or identifier
principles.text: For a role, cause or identifier, exclude the employer, resulting effect or descriptive subtitle unless requested.
For names and places, keep the full entity with its own qualifiers; exclude sentence-introducing words and adjacent addresses or divisions.

principles.scope: Amounts, counts, dates and numeric identifiers
principles.text: For numeric/date fields, keep value, units, precision and bounds. Exclude labels, blank slots and page ornaments; do not invent zeros or remove signs.
For table values, match row, column and period. Compare the requested measure and units across eligible rows, not a neighboring count or rate.

principles.scope: Exact text, numbers, names and typography
principles.text: Copy source word forms and abbreviations, not familiar alternatives. Use straight quotes; do not add spacing within numbers or punctuation.
Inspect only when uncertain characters change the answer. Confirm the field against its original-page label; stop when the reading is clear.
